evidence.sentence: Our Company is ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 22000:2018 certified and is led by a experienced board of directors, and a professional and experienced management team with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical.

India’s pharmaceutical sector boasts high rates of quality compliance, with 70311 US FDA approved facilities (as of April 2023), 38612 European GMP-compliant plants (as of November 2022) and 241813 WHO-GMP-approved plants.
Our focus on quality is evidenced by the quality certification from ISO 9001:2015 for maintaining quality standards and ISO 14001:2015 for meeting safe environmental standards and policies.
